list_intro: Manage built-in services, chat channels, data sources, and installed extensions in one place.
empty_filtered_detail: Nothing matches this capability filter yet. Switch filters or browse the Extension Market to add more.
empty_all_detail: Browse the Extension Market to connect chat channels, data sources, tools, or themes.
push_source_description: Receives items pushed directly from a paired device, such as Apple Shortcuts.
thread_mode_description: Choose whether group chats and topics share your default destination or open separate Persona conversations.
thread_mode_default_desc: All messages follow the "Send to" destination above.
thread_mode_group_topic_desc: Each topic gets its own chat, regular groups share one chat per group, and direct messages use the default destination.
thread_mode_topic_desc: Each topic gets its own chat; regular groups and direct messages follow the default destination.
thread_idle_hours_title: Start a new chat after inactivity (hours)
thread_idle_hours_description: Enter 0 to use the default 30-day window. When a routed group or topic stays quiet longer than this many hours, the next message starts a fresh conversation.
routing_hub_unsupported: Update this assistant to configure group/topic routing and idle timeout.
routing_saved: Saved. New incoming messages will follow this routing immediately.
mail_description: Connect email accounts so Persona can read, search, and bring important mail into your Inbox.
lark_gateway_description: Status and display preferences for the hub's Lark gateway.
feishu_bot_description: Talk to Persona from Feishu or Lark, pair your account, and control notifications and group topics.
saved_repositories_hint: Manage bound repository identities and aliases in Assistant settings.
knowledge_scope_hint: Choose which chats, folders, and documents are indexed into Knowledge.
